biggest_catch: The per-referral amount depends on when the referred account was opened: $100 applies only to qualifying accounts opened on or after 3/1/2026; earlier accounts earn the referrer only $50. Participant rewards cap at $500 per calendar year.
catches: The referred friend must open a qualifying checking account within 90 days of program registration and complete all qualifying activities.
Consumer checking: at least 10 debit-card transactions of $10 or more and at least two direct deposits of at least $500, all posting within 90 days of account opening.
Business checking: at least 10 payment transactions of at least $25 and at least $2,000 in total deposits within 90 days.
The referred friend must not have been a primary owner of a First Financial Bank checking account in the past 12 months.
Participants (referrer, referred, or both) can receive up to $500 per calendar year; partial rewards are not given.
Reward is a virtual Visa reward card delivered to the registered program email; it expires 6 months after issuance.
Only the first referrer who registers the referred individual receives the reward.
Referrer must be an active customer in good standing with an eligible checking account and register for the program.
The program may be changed or canceled at any time.

c1.evidence: Verifiable program on institution's official domain: First Financial Bank's official refer-a-friend terms (bankatfirst.com) allow the referrer to earn a reward for registering and referring individuals.

c2.evidence: Concrete per-referral payout: the referrer is eligible to receive a $100 virtual Visa reward card for each referred individual who completes all qualifying activities for qualifying consumer or business checking accounts opened on or after 3/1/2026; $50 for accounts opened before 3/1/2026.

c3.evidence: Mechanism: the referrer must register for the program and refer the individual by email (valid address) or by sharing a unique referral link via social media or text with the required disclosure; the referred individual must register using that link.

c4.evidence: Timing: approximately 3 weeks after completion of the qualifying activities, delivered to the registered program email address.

eligibility: First Financial Bank active customers in good standing, 18 or older, with an eligible checking account, who register for the refer-a-friend program.
notes: First Financial Bank (bankatfirst.com, Ohio). Distinct from First Financial FCU (R4294, tell-a-friend) and from catalog bank-bonus R0068 (unverified checking bonus). The $100 tier applies to accounts opened on or after 3/1/2026; use $50 as the minimum.
numeric_basis: Per-referral payout of $100.00 for accounts opened on/after 3/1/2026; $50.00 for accounts opened before; participant cap $500/year.
payout_quote: Referrer Reward: Referrer is eligible to receive a $100 Reward for each Referred Individual who completes all Qualifying Activities for Qualifying Consumer or Business Checking Accounts opened on or after 3/1/2026 during the Program Period. ... Payment of Reward: The Reward will be in the form of a virtual Visa Reward Card and will be delivered to your registered Program email address. Please allow approximately 3 weeks after completion of the Qualifying Activities for delivery of the virtual reward. Maximum Reward: Participants, whether acting as a Referred Individual, Referrer or both, can receive up to $500 per calendar year in Rewards.
payout_value_note: $100 per qualifying referral for accounts opened on/after 3/1/2026 ($50 before); reward is a virtual Visa card.

s1.note: No upfront fee charged to the referrer.

s2.note: Program registration and referral are free.

s3.note: Rewards are subject to IRS tax reporting; the recipient is responsible for reporting taxable income.

s4.note: Participants can receive up to $500 per calendar year; no partial rewards.

s5.note: Current official terms on the institution's own domain; the program runs until canceled.

s6.note: Referral mechanics stated on official terms: register, then email the friend or share a unique link with the required disclosure.

s7.note: Friend-side qualifying actions: register via the link, open a qualifying checking account within 90 days, and complete transaction/deposit requirements within 90 days of account opening (10 debit transactions of $10+ and two $500+ direct deposits for consumer checking; 10 payments of $25+ and $2,000 in deposits for business checking).

steps: Register for the First Financial Bank refer-a-friend program.
Email your friend or share your unique referral link with the required disclosure.
Your friend registers via your link and opens a qualifying checking account within 90 days.
Your friend completes the qualifying transaction and direct-deposit requirements within 90 days of account opening.
A $100 virtual Visa reward card (for accounts opened on/after 3/1/2026) is delivered to your registered email approximately 3 weeks after qualification (up to $500/year).
timing: Approximately 3 weeks after completion of the qualifying activities.
